description: Find browser games matching stated gameplay preferences and device. Each result explains its catalog matches. Matches catalog text and optional exact category/tags; ordering is relevance then title, not popularity or an editorial rating.

category.description: Exact catalog category, e.g. puzzle, card, board, clicker.

device.description: A supported device listed by the game publisher; not a guarantee for every browser.

preferences.description: A concise gameplay preference, e.g. idle or sudoku. Use a short phrase rather than a full question.

name: recommend_games
title: Recommend matching games
